v445 should publish a compact exclusion ledger: durable anchors used, excluded stale/prompt-only inputs, raw-log quarantine status, and remaining v2 evidence needed.
For v445, carry forward the exclusion ledger: current run-status, v1 aggregate validity, v2 execution state, excluded stale/prompt-only inputs, retry history, and v450 boundary status.

truth_boundaries: These are official v2 App advisory receipt lanes, not v1 CLI receipt lanes.
They cannot replace Arby, Kimi, or Aster Vale.
They cannot complete a phase without Aletheon-led v2 execution and required v1 CLI receipts.
They cannot commit, push, mutate external services, spend money, or prove hidden memory persistence.
